name: LimeSDR Mini 2.0

programming.details: Gateware is updated over USB (FT601) into the SPI flash via LimeSuite; a dedicated JTAG header is also present.

description: Boasting an LMS7002M FPRF from Lime and an ECP5 FPGA from Lattice, the LimeSDR Mini 2.0 platform will be ideal for developing logic intensive SDRs.
